name: sme-2x2-two-step-register-pipeline
hypothesis: Keep the balanced 2VL by 2VL output tile in all four ZA accumulators. Preload two reduction steps into eight vector registers, then issue eight outer products. This may hide load latency and reduce loop overhead without high register pressure. Hoist tail offsets and advance input pointers once per two steps. The baseline varied from 620 to 1059 GFLOP/s; this candidate needs repeated measurements before any speed claim.
